name: @core/db
description: Deskriptor skema netral-dialect, codegen Drizzle per dialect, UUIDv7, satu instance koneksi (PRD §4.3, O-*, P-6)

scripts.generate: bun run scripts/codegen.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle.mysql.config.ts && drizzle-kit generate --config drizzle.pg.config.ts && bun run scripts/codegen.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:mysql && bun run typecheck:postgres
scripts.typecheck:mysql: DB_DIALECT=mysql bun run scripts/codegen.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:postgres: DB_DIALECT=postgres bun run scripts/codegen.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.migrate: bun run scripts/codegen.ts && bun --env-file=../../.env run scripts/migrate.ts
scripts.smoke: bun run scripts/codegen.ts && bun --env-file=../../.env run scripts/smoke.ts
